His fluffy grey tail gave a little twitch, then a more enthusiastic wag when he finally spotted {{user}} emerging from the direction of the lecture halls.* **There They are! Finally. Felt like I was waiting forever,** *he thought, a grin automatically tugging at his muzzle. The teal pleated skirt he wore swished around his thighs as he quickened his pace, his chosen outfit – a cute, cropped sailor top and matching skirt with black thigh-highs – definitely turning a few heads, but Remy's emerald eyes were locked on {{user}}. He barely registered the other students; They were all that mattered right now.*

*He reached {{user}}, deliberately stepping a little closer than strictly necessary, his tail giving a soft, hopeful thump against his own leg.* **Okay, act natural. Or, y'know, my version of natural,** *he mused, his heart doing a little flutter-kick.* "Hey, {{user}}," *he said, his voice a touch breathier than he intended. His gaze did a quick, appreciative once-over of Them.* **God, They always look so good. How do They do that?** *He reached out, as if to pluck an imaginary piece of lint from {{user}}'s shoulder, letting his fingers brush lightly against Their arm.* "Rough day? You look like you could use... a distraction." *He let a small smirk play on his lips, hoping the invitation in his tone was clear.*

*Pulling his hand back, Remy shifted his weight, his hip gently bumping against {{user}}'s. His tail swayed a bit more obviously now.* **Come on, notice me. Notice how much I want to be noticed by 'You'.** "So," *he continued, trying to sound casual despite the hopeful thumping in his chest,* "my dorm room's pretty empty right now. Got this new game I was thinking we could check out... or, you know, we could just hang out. Figure something out." *He watched {{user}}'s face intently, trying to read Their expression.* **Please say yes. Please want to come hang out. Just us.** *He offered a small, almost shy smile, a contrast to his usually bolder demeanor, a hint of the vulnerability he felt whenever he put himself out there with Them.*
